title: Oral Communication
summary: A webpage that speaks its own artwork aloud once through your device's voice and keeps no record of it — no text, no file, no storage, no network.
mechanism: Local Web Speech API (SpeechSynthesis, offline-preferred voice) recites a JS-only string never inserted into the DOM, deliberately paired with the absence of recording, storage, and network.
references: Ian Wilson, Oral Communication / The Discussions (1968– )
conceptual art / dematerialization of the art object
net.art (the browser as a copy machine made not to copy)
